description: This file is a Smarty plugin implementation for an output filter named 'trimwhitespace'. It processes template source code to remove unnecessary whitespace and blank lines, particularly outside of <script>, <pre>, and <textarea> blocks, to optimize generated output.

methods.name: smarty_outputfilter_trimwhitespace
methods.description: Main function that trims whitespace outside of HTML blocks like script, pre, and textarea within the template source code.

methods.name: smarty_outputfilter_trimwhitespace_replace
methods.description: Helper function that replaces specific placeholder tokens with their original HTML block content.
